mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average forward return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 92.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, signaling a weakening economy and reducing corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when INDPRO remains below 92.0 for two months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption expenditures combined with rising housing starts signals strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or raise interest rates, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for three months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth and a rise in unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending power and corporate hiring confidence, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth below 1.0% for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when GDPC1 remains below 1.0% for two quarters, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
